work_experience.description: Developed core features for the Sendr DeFi exchange, including liquidity pool creation, token swapping, Uniswap integration, real-time services (WebSocket, ZeroMQ), and robust blockchain event listeners with monitoring, logging, and rate limiting. Built and published two npm packages (Web3 Deposit Sync & Web3 Deposit Detect) using TypeScript for real-time blockchain transaction monitoring, detection, and filtering. Contributed to an internal HRM system by implementing frontend and backend features such as authentication, role-based access control, database backup, and file synchronization.

Contributed to the development of PAB, a social media platform for book readers, implementing friend management, real-time chat, referral & rewards system, news/events, and club management features. Implemented a reliable database backup system integrated with Google Drive. Developed user features including profile picture uploads and user promotion systems. Contributed to DeFi Exchange Application (Sendr) by working on core backend functionalities using Node.js and MongoDB.

projects.name: Sendr - DeFi Exchange Application
projects.description: DeFi Exchange Application by working on core backend functionalities using Node.js and MongoDB. Developed key features for a DeFi Exchange platform. Including liquidity pool creation, token swapping, and Uniswap integration. Built real-time services using WebSocket and ZeroMQ-based IPC communication. Implemented blockchain event listeners for smart contracts and Uniswap, along with rate limiting, logging, monitoring, and heartbeat mechanisms for system stability.

projects.name: Studio Management System
projects.description: Mentored: Optimize Solutions Pvt Ltd. Developed Super Admin functionalities including admin management and system-wide user oversight. Implemented profile management features for administrators, enabling account updates and role-based access control. Built secure authentication and authorization mechanisms for all user types. Developed login, forgot password, and password reset functionalities with secure user verification workflows.

projects.name: Plant Management System QA Automation Framework
projects.description: Developed a scalable automated testing framework for a E-commerce System covering both UI and backend API testing. Implemented End-to-End (E2E) test automation for inventory management, category handling, authentication, and sales workflows across Admin and User roles. Applied Behavior-Driven Development (BDD) using Cucumber.js and Gherkin syntax to create readable and maintainable test scenarios. Utilized the Page Object Model (POM) design pattern with Playwright to improve test maintainability and reusability. Integrated API validations and automated form validation testing to ensure data integrity and business logic reliability.
